findings: Viewer clamps index to last item, not to a matching mediaKey. Parent filters missing media items while passing raw group index, so selecting b at raw index 1 in [missing,b,c] displays c in filtered [b,c]. Static parent/child composition, not rendered reproduction.

Index resets to initialIndex when items array identity changes. Bounds clamp only upper side; negative externally supplied index can dereference undefined, though normal caller indices are nonnegative.
Image previews are viewport-sized thumbnails based on pixel ratio, not original resolution or full video playback; viewing them does not prove exact image/video equality.

useGroupBlobUrls fetches every group image concurrently and prefetches every next-group image. There is no explicit concurrency/memory budget or request timeout. Abort and created-URL revocation on cleanup are present.

Effect dependency thumbKey includes concatenated URLs but not mediaKey or viewport dimensions. Same ordered thumbs with changed media IDs leave mapping keyed to old IDs; resize alone does not refetch.
Failed preview fetch has no error state; FullResImage continues showing spinner when URL absent.

Keyboard Keep/Trash operations delegate to caller; last-kept protection remains caller responsibility. While nested shortcuts dialog is open, outer window listener remains installed. Runtime focus routing unverified.
limits: Static review; no rendered viewer, image downloads, video playback, keyboard event simulation or browser execution.
